items.title: Paquito D'Rivera — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I did my first tour in Europe, she organize it with a lady called Gabby Kleinschmit

ctx.x: The Jazz Showcase and so many other places you know. In Boston, The Regatta Bar Helen Keane was very well connected because of her work with Bill Evans and Al Farmer. So, she use her connection to get me gigs in Europe also, toured some eight years in Europe. I did my first tour in Europe, she organize it with a lady called Gabby Kleinschmit, and that, all that was promoting those CBS records.
Did you begin to play festivals?
